title: ArcCivs compact generated gate material debit 2026-11-02
assumptions: Alternative generated-only 3x3 gate, not an additional payment for a 5x5 gate.
Participants 1/3/10 settlements; assumed 0/1/4 new compact gates per settlement-day. Sensitivity inputs are not measured throughput.
Flat source counts price every authored cell from air. Existing matching native cells and KEEP_NATIVE floor are excluded from the real ordinary construction bill.
Admitted one-block stepped profile varies only logs 13-15. Flat13 is used by the evaluator.
No direct Vault, premium token, player XP, refund or drop issuance. Current SELL and future SELL-to-contract remain separate and unchanged.
